project_type: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript booking automation app with a separate BullMQ worker process
build_system: npm + Next.js. Prisma generates a client to ../generated/prisma (schema prisma/schema.prisma). tsx runs TS directly (worker, scripts, tests).
test_framework: node:test via `tsx --test tests/*.test.ts`. Integration tests (holds, payments) self-skip when DATABASE_URL is unset; signature.test.ts is pure-logic and needs no DB.
build_command: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit). NOTE: cannot run in this sandbox - see environment_constraints.
test_command: npm test (tsx --test tests/*.test.ts). NOTE: cannot run in this sandbox - see environment_constraints.
verification_instructions: Intended: run `npm install`, `npx prisma generate`, then `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`. In THIS sandbox none of those can run because the npm registry is blocked. Best-effort validation available: the host has a GLOBAL TypeScript 5.9.2 (`tsc`) and node v22.23.3. Use `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck <file.ts>` for per-file syntax/type sanity on new/changed files (expect unresolved-module errors for `@/...`, `bullmq`, `@/generated/prisma` because node_modules is empty - those are environment noise, not real defects). Review logic by reading, mirror existing patterns exactly.
snapshot_or_generated_files: generated/prisma is the generated Prisma client (gitignored, produced by `prisma generate`). It is NOT present and cannot be generated in this sandbox (registry blocked). Prisma migrations under prisma/migrations/ ARE checked in and must be hand-written following existing style when the schema changes.
setup_instructions: Normally: `npm install` then `npx prisma migrate dev` (or `prisma generate`) then `npm run db:seed`. In this sandbox `npm install` hangs/fails: the proxy returns HTTP 403 for every registry.npmjs.org tarball and pnpm cannot reach metadata at all. node_modules contains only empty placeholder dirs. Do NOT attempt to run npm install/npx - it will time out. Unset NODE_OPTIONS before any node/tsc command: NODE_OPTIONS points at a missing preload file (/opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js) that crashes every node process otherwise.
environment_constraints: HARD BLOCKER: npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) is blocked by the sandbox proxy - all tarball GETs return 403, pnpm metadata fetch fails. Dependencies cannot be installed; the Prisma client cannot be generated; therefore `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` CANNOT be executed here. There is no Postgres or Redis running either, so even integration tests would self-skip. Available for validation: global `tsc` (TypeScript 5.9.2) and node v22. Always `unset NODE_OPTIONS` in each shell command (the configured preload file is missing and crashes node). The orchestrator/CI will run the real build and tests after merge.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Conventions inferred from code: all work on branch phase-5-reminders-and-retries (already created, do NOT commit to main). Commit locally with clear messages; do NOT push or open a PR (the orchestrator does that). Follow existing phase migration-dir naming (prisma/migrations/<yyyymmddHHMMSS>_<name>/migration.sql).
key_patterns: Deterministic BullMQ job ids for idempotency (lib/queue.ts createMeetingJobId, enqueueCreateMeeting with attempts:5 + exponential backoff delay 5000 + removeOnComplete age 7d + removeOnFail:false). requeue* helpers remove a finished (failed/completed) job before re-adding, and leave waiting/active/delayed jobs alone. Business logic lives in lib/*.ts and ALWAYS re-reads the latest booking row at run time (lib/meeting.ts createMeetingForBooking) - never trust enqueue-time data. Idempotent updateMany with a status guard in the WHERE clause (status:'PAID', eventId:null) to avoid races. Errors classified GoogleReconnectError / GoogleRequestError / GoogleTransientError; worker wraps unrecoverable ones in UnrecoverableError so BullMQ stops retrying, rethrows transient ones for backoff. Alerts go through lib/alerts.ts alertInfluencer({kind, detail, bookingId}); booking.lastError backs the dashboard flag. Dependency-injection via an overrides/deps object with defaults (MeetingDeps) makes handlers unit-testable without Redis/Google/DB - mirror this for reminders. Path alias @/* -> project root (tsconfig). lib/google.ts is a GoogleClient interface over fetch with a createGoogleClient(fetchImpl) factory for testing.
